Algorithm 1: RepTrace: LLM DNA Extraction Pipeline
Input : Max length \( m \); sample size \( t \); DNA dimension \( L \); sentence-embedding model \( \phi : \Sigma^* \to \mathbb{R}^p \);
    A sample input set \( \mathcal{S}_t = \{x_1, \ldots, x_t\} \) drawn uniformly from real-world datasets;
    A collection of LLMs \( \mathcal{F}_K = \{f_1, \ldots, f_K\} \subset \mathcal{F} \).
Output: DNA vectors \( \{\tau_f \in \mathbb{R}^L : f \in \mathcal{F}_K\} \).
Initialize random Gaussian projection: draw \( A \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times (p \cdot t)} \) with \( A_{jk} \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1/\sqrt{L}) \).
foreach \( f \in \mathcal{F}_K \) do
    for \( i \leftarrow 1 \) to \( t \) do
        \( y_i \leftarrow f(x_i) \) // Textual response of \( f \) on input \( x_i \)
        \( e_i \leftarrow \phi(y_i) \in \mathbb{R}^p \) // Semantic embedding
    \( E_f \leftarrow [e_1, e_2, \ldots, e_t] \in \mathbb{R}^{p \cdot t} \) // Concatenate response embeddings
    \( \tau_f \leftarrow A E_f \in \mathbb{R}^L \) // Project into DNA space
return \( \{\tau_f : f \in \mathcal{F}_K\} \)
